answers.industry: Accounting, bookkeeping, and tax document preparation services
answers.summary: Track physical and digital accounting document batches from receiving through custody, review, and release without encoding every receipt.
answers.stack: TypeScript workspace with React/Vite client, Fastify API, repository interfaces, and local SQLite for the synthetic pilot; PostgreSQL and private object storage required before production
answers.deployment: Local zero-cost synthetic pilot; managed Singapore-region services only after privacy, ownership, backup, and recurring-cost approval
answers.auth: Invite-only email and password with server-side role/client authorization; MFA mandatory for owner and staff before production
answers.sensitivity: Confidential financial, identity, payroll, banking, sales, and tax-related documents
answers.designDirection: Friendly, calm, non-technical, mobile-first, trustworthy blue/indigo and warm neutral
answers.languages: English first with Filipino helper text for client-facing instructions and errors
answers.accessibility: At least 16px body text, strong contrast, keyboard access, visible focus, labeled controls, large touch targets, screen-reader status, reduced motion, and no color-only status
answers.platforms: Responsive web for office computers and Android/iPhone browsers
answers.browserSupport: Latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari
answers.constraints: Use synthetic data and zero-cost local infrastructure for the pilot. Preserve portable data/repository boundaries and prohibit real client data until production controls are approved.
answers.approvalRule: Plan first, then wait for my approval before coding
